newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Mahathir starts two-month break.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir starts two-month break.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad left for London late on Sunday to begin a two-month vacation, Malaysian newspapers said on Monday.
The Prime Minister will visit several countries including Poland, Hungary and Switzerland as part of his work-and-rest break.

In London, Mahathir, who is accompanied by his wife Siti Hasmah, is expected to address entrepreneurs in the information technology business to promote the Multimedia Super Corridor, a high technology zone being created near Kuala Lumpur.
The newspapers said he will call on the new British Prime Minister Tony Blair on Monday.
Mahathir said on Saturday financial markets should not worry as Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has been given full authority to run the country.
"He knows my views, I know his views and basically we don't disagree," Mahathir told reporters.
"And of course if there is anything special, I will have to cut short my leave."
Foreign exchange dealers said in early May that Mahathir's planned leave had led to speculation about his health and to weakness in the ringgit.
